critical_code_review_comments: Per-user shop token format `{user_id}.{HMAC(password_hash[:16])}` correctly invalidates old tokens after a password change — verified: old token returns 401 on /shop/me after rotate.
/api/shop/login per-user path correctly returns 401 for unknown email and 401 for wrong password (NOT 403, which is reserved for disabled users — this matches the PM portal contract).
/api/admin/shop-users/{id}/email-welcome guards behind require_admin_strict (admin-only, no PM passthrough) and returns 503 cleanly when RESEND_API_KEY is missing.
Disabled shop user cannot log in (login returns 401/403) — disable flag honored by find_shop_user_by_email path.

/api/shop/me correctly distinguishes per-user token (returns user doc) from admin/shared token (returns is_legacy=true). NOTE: when both X-Admin-Token and X-Shop-Token are sent, the admin path wins because require_shop_or_admin checks admin first — this means the conftest.py auto-injection had to be defeated with a bogus admin token in tests. Production frontend never sends both, so this is correct behavior.
Frontend /shop/login no longer mentions 'optional — leave blank for shared shop password'. Email is hard-required client-side (toast 'Enter your work email').
/shop/change-password mirrors /pm/change-password exactly: old + new + confirm, on success persists fresh token and redirects to /shop. Toast 'Password updated' confirms success.

AdminShopUsersPanel issue-password dialog has the spec'd 3 buttons (Cancel, Show on Screen, Email to User). 'Show on Screen' calls /set-password and renders the 10-char temp pw in a select-all amber-bordered code box — verified visually.

rca of the issue: No bugs found this iteration. The 7 initial test failures were ALL test-harness artifacts caused by /app/backend/tests/conftest.py monkey-patching every requests call to auto-inject X-Admin-Token. This made (a) 'no auth' negative tests return 200 because admin token was silently attached, (b) the /set-password 'requires admin' negative test actually succeeded and rotated the temp pw mid-run, breaking the subsequent login test, and (c) per-user /shop/me + /shop/change-password tests fell into the admin/legacy path because admin token won over shop token in require_shop_or_admin. Fix: send a bogus X-Admin-Token explicitly (defeats setdefault in conftest) so the request truly goes shop-only or no-auth. After the fix all 20 tests pass and the underlying backend behavior is verified correct via direct curl as well.
